subject: re-dif
title: RE.DEF.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 444 (EXT.F(II)-6). RE-DIF (redefinitions) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. The title names RE-DEF (redefinition); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: MT-INTR (multiple interpretation), AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) and SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From MT-INTR: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From AFL-DY: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From SOC-RT-DY: POL-P (political policies). From LANG-DY: AF-CON (affinity convergence). From POL-P: APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions). From AF-CON: ALT-F (alternative functionalism).
